frozen_items_affected: F1 — the typed enumerations carried in event payloads: FailureCode gains exactly nine members (RFC §22.1); the journal gains format 3 with a schema for all 29 event types and a required provider/request.budget_owner (§20.1)

promoted_from.note: the WP-6.2 §2 read-only pre-code schema-fit audit (STOP report, 2026-09-25), copied byte-identically from the diagnostics directory; it is the measured defect this exception is bound to

supersedes.note: V2-004 proposed three TESTS_* codes and a tests/adequacy schema for the engineering-quality paths only; V2-005 narrows its tests semantics (an integration-owned INCOMPLETE collection is not a FailureCode; TESTS_NOT_COLLECTABLE_UNDETERMINED is not added) and covers every non-representable path (digest of the proposal document with its SUPERSEDED / NOT APPLIED header)

contradiction_discovered: The frozen orchestration semantics (RFC §16 verifier disagreement and probe mismatch, §26 merge conflict and post-merge re-proof, §15.3 engineering-test adequacy, §25 reviewer and security findings and capability failures, §17.1 resource acquisition, §22 typed budgets) require typed states that journal format 2, the sealed FailureCode set and the provider-request budget semantics (every request charged to the developer) cannot represent. Measured, read-only, before any orchestration code: 11 of the required WP-6.2 paths DOES_NOT_FIT; four EventTypes (plan/static-admitted, proof/verified, tests/adequacy, invariant/violated) have no schema in any format.

paths_that_do_not_fit: instrument identity mismatch between implementer and verifier records (PROBE_MISMATCH, §16 rule 2)
engineering-quality checks — UNRUNNABLE execution => environment failure (§15.3)
engineering-quality checks — INADEQUATE => DEVELOPER (where policy permits blocking, §15.3)
reviewer environment failure => ENVIRONMENT, never DEVELOPER (ORCH-6)
security scanner executes and finds issues => EXECUTED, never UNRUNNABLE (ORCH-7); findings => owner SECURITY
merge conflict => INTEGRATION, zero developer charge (ORCH-8)
environment failure while acquiring a scope resource (worktree, sandbox)

discovered_in.flagged_by_implementation: AISEF V2 — WP-6.2 STOPPED AT §2 (schema-fit audit): 11 DOES_NOT_FIT paths; no orchestration code written

owner_decision.approved: V2-005 APPROVED; the STOP accepted; V2-004 SUPERSEDED / NEVER APPLIED; WP-6.2 resumes only after this amendment is recorded, freeze and conformance are regenerated and the amendment-specific tests pass; WP-6.3 not authorized
refinements: journal FORMAT 3: format 2 remains a supported historical reader/writer exactly; no rewrite or migration of old journals; schemas for all 29 EventTypes, each derived from existing frozen typed objects; no new EventType; no prose field as control

proof/verified is a lossless VerifiedProof (spec identity, candidate identity, both results' identity and evidence, agreement, verdict only with agreement); immutable source-seq references are permitted when exact reconstruction is mechanically proven

tests/adequacy serialises the WP-5 typed result with the two-axis semantics; TESTS_UNRUNNABLE (ENVIRONMENT, retryable) and TESTS_INADEQUATE (DEVELOPER, retryable); TESTS_NOT_COLLECTABLE_UNDETERMINED is NOT added; an integration-owned INCOMPLETE collection is recorded in tests/adequacy and gate evidence only — never failure/observed, never rollback or retry by itself
invariant/violated carries the invariant id, the owning module and diagnostic context (evidence only, never routing); InvariantError stays uncontainable; no correctness depends on appending it
plan/static-admitted is the StaticPlanAdmissionResult; WP-6.2 need not run static admission at runtime

exactly nine FailureCodes: VERIFIER_DISAGREEMENT INTEGRATION retryable=false; PROBE_MISMATCH INTEGRATION retryable=false; MERGE_CONFLICT INTEGRATION retryable=false; TESTS_UNRUNNABLE ENVIRONMENT retryable=true; TESTS_INADEQUATE DEVELOPER retryable=true; REVIEW_FINDING REVIEW retryable=true; SECURITY_FINDING SECURITY retryable=true; CAPABILITY_UNRUNNABLE ENVIRONMENT retryable=true; RESOURCE_ACQUISITION_FAILED ENVIRONMENT retryable=true; a tenth is a STOP

format-3 provider/request requires budget_owner: Owner (cycle 1: DEVELOPER, REVIEW, SECURITY); budgets charge budget_owner and never default it; provider failure keeps owner PROVIDER; format-2 semantics unchanged

review = provider/request + provider/result + gate/check; a model review alone is never the sole blocking authority; REVIEW_FINDING only with corroborated authority; reviewer outage stays PROVIDER; a capability that cannot run is CAPABILITY_UNRUNNABLE / ENVIRONMENT
security = tool/invoked + tool/result + gate/check; ran-and-found is EXECUTED; SECURITY_FINDING typed from the adapter result, never parsed text
MERGE_CONFLICT and RESOURCE_ACQUISITION_FAILED never from stderr text
the six projections stay the closed list; only their handling of the new typed events and codes is extended; reference models updated independently; no side counters; no seventh projection
P5 sealed: P5-FINAL-SEAL not regenerated; P5 evidence files not mutated; current HEAD conformance may cite V2-005
no Owner change, no EventType member added, no change to the six projections' identity

replacement.summary: Journal format 3 (aisef2/journal/format3.py): the format-1 and format-2 schemas as they were, five re-declared (run/begin accepts 3; failure/observed carries the whole §22.1 taxonomy; provider/request requires budget_owner; plan/static-admitted, proof/verified, tests/adequacy, invariant/violated gain schemas), a format-aware reader that reads formats 1, 2 and 3 each under its own rules and refuses any other, and a writer that never extends a format-1 or format-2 journal. FailureCode = the 13 historical codes (the only ones formats 1 and 2 may carry) + the nine V2-005 codes. budgets projection version 2 charges a format-3 request to its budget_owner; story_state version 2 admits proof/verified and tests/adequacy in ACTIVE; invariant/violated is ignored by every projection.
not_changed: formats 1 and 2 as written: schemas, readers, writers, repair closers, evidence

f1_impact: FailureCode: 13 -> 22 members; journal format 3 declared; provider/request gains a required field under format 3 only. Existing events are not re-interpreted: a format-1 or format-2 journal is read exactly as before, and the new codes are refused there (FMT3-5).
evidence_compatibility_impact: Evidence written under formats 1 and 2 is unchanged and still validates under its own format. No format-2 journal is rewritten or auto-upgraded (FMT3-7). P1–P4 evidence records whose derivation includes the taxonomy, the projection versions or the run scope's journal format are re-derived at this candidate (the precedent of the P2, P4 and P5 candidates); P1–P5 seal records stay byte-identical; P5 evidence files stay byte-identical and are verified by identity against P5-FINAL-SEAL rather than re-derived (validation/v2/p5_evidence.py --check).
implementation_decisions_for_owner_revie: formats 1 and 2 enforce their historical code set (FORMAT_2_CODES) in their failure/observed schema: a new code in an old format is refused rather than read (FMT3-5)

proof/verified cites the two immutable probe/evaluated records (implementer, verifier) by seq; format3.verified_proof(event, prior) reconstructs the VerifiedProof mechanically and the schema rule proves instrument identity and agreement from the cited records
post-merge re-proof at the merged revision happens before story/commit, so its probe/evaluated records stay within the attempt and a POST_MERGE_REGRESSION still rolls the story back
P3-PROJECTION-SEMANTICS.md gains version-2 sections for budgets and story_state (the precedent: the document was extended after the P3 seal by P4 and its post-seal hygiene)
RFC §22.1 pins the 13 historical codes exactly as sealed with P1 (V2-003 included) — no semantic change to them — so 'no other code' is mechanically checkable (F1.failure_taxonomy)

the P5-INVARIANTS record cannot be re-derived byte-identically at any later HEAD (its mechanism digest hashes mechanism module sources; its except-boundary count grows with the kernel), so the sealed P5 records are identity-checked against the seal
